title: Mars Isn't Dead... Something May Still Be Burning Beneath It
description:
Scientists have detected hydrogen chloride above volcanic cracks near Alba Mons on Mars.

Could magma still be moving beneath the Red Planet?

A new study suggests Mars may not be as geologically inactive as we once thought.

But there is one important detail: no new eruption has been directly observed.

Science is stranger than you think.

Sources:
